svg.title: Private files: authorize before direct transfer
svg.desc: Returning a URL issues access credentials; it does not transfer a file. The browser then contacts storage, which checks the signature and expiry. Upload Content-Type must match the signed value. publicUrl only computes the configured public address.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
